prompts.main: Use case: precise-object-edit. Project game background production asset. Edit the provided approved 16:9 pixel art main menu screenshot. Keep the EXACT composition, title '24시간의 사투' at upper left, pink stomach tissue floor, open ivory and mint medicine capsule, needle case, herbal bag, anatomical scroll, ice cubes, ginseng and heart pouch. Remove ONLY all four chick characters (red runner on capsule, blue lower left, yellow lower center, pink lower right), purple germ next to pink chick, their floating motion sparks, and ALL four menu buttons on the right. Cleanly reconstruct the stomach/capsule background under removed objects. This is a clean background layer for animated characters and live UI to be composited back into exactly the original places. Keep title and all other props unchanged. Crisp clean large readable pixel clusters, no new elements, no speckled texture, no blurry painterly detail. Wide 16:9 output, opaque.
